name: forgepact-panel
description: ForgePact's control panel frontend: built to static files that src/forgepact.py serves and PyInstaller bundles.

scripts.oracle:replay: node tests/oracle.mjs replay --oracle tests/behaviour-oracle.json --derived tests/behaviour-oracle-derived.json --supplement tests/behaviour-oracle-gems.json --key-supplement tests/behaviour-oracle-primeevil.json
scripts.oracle:derive: node tests/oracle-derive.mjs --from tests/behaviour-oracle.json --supplement tests/behaviour-oracle-gems.json --key-supplement tests/behaviour-oracle-primeevil.json --out tests/behaviour-oracle-derived.json
